storage_root.label: Storage root (absolute path inside the toolbox; exactly ONE toolbox instance may use a given store — a second instance sharing it is unsupported and needs a real distributed lock)

allowed_folders.label: Folders this scope may use (comma-separated folder codes; empty denies everything)

limits/max_diff_bytes.label: Max diff bytes returned to the agent

security/allow_symlinks.label: Allow symbolic links (only false is supported)
